title: MACH Factory Intake Ledger v1
description: The Factory's record of approved product work it has taken in: .factory/intake/ledger.json, git-ignored and machine-local. It maps each slice revision to its execution ticket. Whether work is active or integrated is never stored as fact here; it is read from the cells and from Git each time.

source.description: The integration branch and commit of the last intake.

intakes.description: Keyed by project/wave/content digest: each distinct approved wave content is taken in once.

digest.description: SHA-256 over the work order, the why and the spec: the identity of this slice revision.

pending_ticket.description: True from the moment a ticket is wanted until one is recorded; an interrupted intake finishes from here.

integrated.description: Set once the slice's commit was verified on the integration branch.

built_against.description: The revision of each dependency when this slice was dispatched.

history.description: Earlier revisions and tickets of this slice.

pending_events.description: Events not yet appended to events.jsonl. Part of the ledger until they are in the log.
